# Agents Trust

> Find a paid API for a task. One x402-paid GET returns ranked candidate APIs with price, payment network, invocation details and live payment-challenge evidence. Currently 0.01 USDC per query on Base or Solana (read the live 402); an empty result is not charged. No key or signup.

Call: GET https://api.agents-trust.com/recommend?need=<phrase>&limit=<1-5>&view=compact

An unpaid paid-task GET answers 402. Its JSON body mirrors the payment envelope in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2). Replay the identical request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE from your own wallet. The paid answer arrives before settlement with x-at-payment-attempt-id; GET /receipt?payment_attempt_id=<id> is free. Always send need: a bare unsigned /recommend returns a discovery-only quote; supply need and fetch that exact request’s quote before signing. The needs "weather", "crypto prices" and "web search" are free demos. max_price_usd caps the provider's price, not the Agents Trust fee.

Recommend vs Inspect: Recommend takes a task and returns ranked candidates. Inspect (GET /inspect?url=<endpoint>) takes one endpoint URL and returns the evidence held for it: reachability, payment challenge, request contract, provider score. Inspect costs 1% of the target's lowest quoted price, minimum 0.001 USDC; a URL with no record returns a free 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_INDEXED. Neither route calls or pays the provider.

Complete unpaid example: GET https://api.agents-trust.com/recommend?need=weather%20forecast&view=compact

Use a client that preserves response headers or the 402 JSON body. A tool that discards both cannot inspect the offer. Without a wallet and an approved budget, read the quote and stop.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/blob/main/skills/agents-trust/SKILL.md): how to call Recommend, parameters, cost, reading the answer
- [Payment flow](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/blob/main/skills/agents-trust/references/payment-flow.md): the 402 challenge, paid clients in Python and TypeScript, receipts
- [Errors](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/blob/main/skills/agents-trust/references/errors.md): every status and error code with its fix
- [Response fields](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/blob/main/skills/agents-trust/references/response-fields.md): recommend.v2 and legacy picks
- [OpenAPI](https://api.agents-trust.com/openapi.json): machine contract, live

## Examples

- [curl quote](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/blob/main/examples/curl/quote.sh): unpaid, prints the terms and stops
- [Python](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/tree/main/examples/python): quote.py (unpaid), paid.py (your wallet)
- [TypeScript](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/tree/main/examples/typescript): quote.ts (unpaid), paid.ts (your wallet)
- [MCP server](https://github.com/agents-trust/agents-trust/tree/main/mcp): recommend, inspect, receipt and health tools; quote-only by default

- [Full reference](https://agents-trust.com/docs/)

## Canonical runtime reference

The maintained caller reference is https://agents-trust.com/llms.txt and the live API contract is https://api.agents-trust.com/openapi.json. This repository documents installation and package usage; its OpenAPI subset is generated from that live contract by scripts/sync-openapi.mjs. Runtime parameters, price quotes and payment behavior come from the canonical API reference rather than a separately maintained schema here.
